name: Kevin Sallée
title: Engineering Lead | Senior Software Engineer

summary:
Engineering lead and senior software engineer with 19 years of experience. I decide what to build, design the architecture and lead the team. I build with AI coding agents: they write most of the code, under tests, CI gates and my review.

I spent six years consulting for Marvel, Netflix, Electronic Arts and Warner Bros Animation, from the sales call and the estimate to architecture, delivery and support. I was then Product Manager at Autodesk for Flow Asset Management, and co-founded an AI SaaS that reached public beta in January 2026.

Earlier I was Head of Pipeline at two film studios, where I hired and grew one team from 3 to 20+ developers. My recent work is public: open source tools for agent-led development, including the rules and CI gates that two people and their agents use to ship together.

projects.title: agentkit
projects.description: How two people and their coding agents build a project together: rules, skills, role guides and a design pipeline. Gates check each rule in CI, so a convention stays enforced after people forget it.

projects.title: sg-groundtruth
projects.description: Recorded behaviour of the Flow Production Tracking REST API. 110+ probes each ask a live site one question and store the answer verbatim, so coding agents read real behaviour before they write code against the API. Published on PyPI with a REST client and an MCP server.

projects.title: sg-widgets
projects.description: shadcn-compatible component library for Flow Production Tracking: one headless TypeScript core with no dependencies, React and Svelte layers on top, and a Qt port for desktop tools (sg-widgets-qt).

projects.title: llm-ui-annotation
projects.description: Annotate a running UI in the browser (elements, text, drawings) and hand the feedback to a coding agent, which answers in a thread and marks each item for review. 549 unit tests and 59 Playwright end-to-end tests.
